_why: Weight budget for the lab shell (access-practice-lab/index.html), checked by tools/validate-language-page-performance.mjs. `target` is where the program wants to be (docs/language-page/award-program-prompt.md, workstream 6); `ratchet` is the measurement on 2026-11-25 and may only go DOWN, so growth cannot hide behind a target nobody meets yet. Lower a ratchet to the new measurement whenever a change reduces weight; delete it once it reaches the target. Measured live on 2026-11-24: the home page transferred 1.36 MB over 158 requests, 414 KB of it CSS. The targets below are provisional: set them again with a performance owner once the shell is bundled.
